name: tland
description: A cozy 2D top-down multiplayer world set in a stylized Taipei City.

scripts.build: npm run build -w @tland/shared && npm run build -w @tland/server && npm run build -w @tland/client
scripts.typecheck: npm run build -w @tland/shared && npm run typecheck -w @tland/server && npm run typecheck -w @tland/client
